about.description: Gulf Shores Steamer has been a local family owned restaurant since 1989 in Orange Beach, Alabama. The restaurant specializes in steamed and grilled seafood with the motto "NO FRIED", offering Red Shrimp, Snow Crab Legs, Mussels, Oysters, grilled fish, hand-cut steaks, and the Island's Best Cheeseburger in a casual, laid-back coastal atmosphere.
